name: v2src-w5050
desc: Extrapolate the one weight axis with direct LB evidence. The 0.940->0.941 step moved 0.05 of weight from maxspan-v5 onto its back-to-front twin (0.60/0.10/0.10/0.20 -> 0.55/0.10/0.15/0.20). This takes the next equal step in the same direction: 0.50/0.10/0.20/0.20. If back-to-front averaging is what earned that +0.002, another 0.05 should still be positive; if the axis is flat or already past its optimum, this reads as no movement (rank) and the axis can be abandoned cheaply.
